rule: Frozen sample set of seeds and zones (docs/VERIFICATION.md, anti-bias rule 7). Any change goes through a dedicated pull request that changes nothing else, is never made by the agent that has just met a failure on these samples, and updates the pinned digest in SamplesTest. The null fields of reliefZones are filled the same way, from oracle observations such as /locate, never guessed.
units: Zones are in chunk coordinates with inclusive bounds. Seeds are decimal strings so that no JSON tool rounds them.

seeds.name: long-min
seeds.why: large negative seed whose negation overflows

seeds.name: large-negative
seeds.why: large negative seed with mixed bits

seeds.name: classic
seeds.why: ordinary positive seed, the one of the report example

zones.name: origin-cross
zones.why: crosses the -1/0 border on both axes, which is also a region border

zones.name: region-corner-positive
zones.why: crosses the 31/32 region border on both axes

zones.name: region-corner-negative
zones.why: crosses the -33/-32 region border on both axes

zones.name: region-corner-mixed
zones.why: negative and positive region borders in one zone

zones.name: far-positive
zones.why: about one million blocks from the origin

zones.name: far-negative
zones.why: about minus one million blocks from the origin

reliefZones.description: open water over a sea floor
